errors.evidence: The description identifies one of the metrics as 'QA performance', likely taken from the paper's caption. However, the figure's legend clearly labels this metric as 'Accuracy'.

The description states that the peak for the 'Accuracy' line is at an x-coordinate of approximately 210. Visually, the peak for all three lines occurs at an x-coordinate of approximately 220. The description repeats this error for the 'Confidence' and 'Alignment' lines as well.

The description states that the 'Confidence' line decreases to about 0.60 in the x-range 105-170. However, in this range, the line first decreases from 0.60 (at x=105) to about 0.58 (at x=135) and then rises again to about 0.62 (at x=170). The description oversimplifies this trend and incorrectly states the value at the end of the interval.
